title: Magazine article p. 40 with "McDivitt UFO" Gemini-4 photo (NASA photo 65-H-1013)
description: Photocopied magazine page with a wide photograph at top showing streak-like lens flares, captioned "The 'McDivitt UFO', prize-winning astronaut photograph taken on Gemini-4. Actually, McDivitt explained later after the flight that the sun was coming across the window as the spacecraft rolled, the sun rays struck a metal bolt, causing the flares in the camera lens. NASA photo 65-H-1013." The three-column article below discusses the June 1965 Gemini-4 sighting by James McDivitt, NORAD's list of nearby satellites including Pegasus-2, and the hypothesis that the object was the Gemini booster stage.
